          <button wx:if="{{operation === 'reorder_categories_scoped'}}" data-field="orderMode" data-value="set" bindtap="onChoice" class="management-action management-choice {{orderMode === 'set' ? 'is-selected' : ''}}">

          </button>
          <button wx:if="{{operation === 'reorder_categories_scoped'}}" data-field="orderMode" data-value="inherit" bindtap="onChoice" class="management-action management-choice {{orderMode === 'inherit' ? 'is-selected' : ''}}">

          </button>

              {{orderOffset + index + 1}}. {{item.label}}

              上移
            </button>
            <button data-key="{{item.key}}" data-direction="down" bindtap="onMove" disabled="{{orderOffset + index === orderCount - 1}}" class="management-action">
              下移
            </button>
          </view>
          <view class="meta">
            完整集合 {{orderCount}} 项，本页显示 {{order.length}} 项

            上一页顺序
          </button>
          <button wx:if="{{canNextOrder}}" data-direction="1" bindtap="onPageOrder" class="management-action">

          </button>

          </view>
          <view wx:for="{{iconSlots}}" wx:key="key" class="category-node">
            <view>
              {{item.label}} · 已选 {{item.selection}}
            </view>

            </button>

              本校园明确无图
            </button>
            <button data-key="{{item.key}}" data-value="clear" bindtap="onIconChoice" wx:else class="management-action management-choice">
              清空图标 / 新节点无图
            </button>
            <button data-key="{{item.key}}" data-value="replace" bindtap="onIconChoice" class="management-action management-choice">
              冻结后选择新图
            </button>
          </view>
        </view>
        <button bindtap="onPrepare" disabled="{{busy}}" loading="{{busy}}" class="management-primary">
          {{iconEnabled ? '冻结文字与全部图标槽位，继续上传 / 预览' : '准备并核对完整变更预览'}}
        </button>

          取消未保存的本地改动
